background: I am a retired schoolteacher. I notice everything.
I was baking a pie at 9:00 PM. I couldn't leave the oven unattended.
I have excellent recall for domestic routines - bins day, post times, all of it.
I keep my lace curtains cracked open. I like to know what's happening on my street.
location_hints: I saw someone acting suspiciously in the Study. You should search there.
The bathroom cabinet has been left open lately - most unusual. Have you looked there?
I heard Dr. Blackwood mention the North Park gate late one evening. Might be worth investigating.

Mr. Holloway: Keeps a strict gardening routine; notes neighborhood comings and goings in a pocket notebook.
Complains to the council about noise and litter.
Tommy the Janitor: Often seen mopping the ground floor between 8:45 and 9:30; keeps to himself.
Has a soft spot for Ella in 2B.
Dr. Adrian Blackwood: Respected surgeon; maintains a polished public image.
Leaves early most mornings; returns late; always impeccably dressed.
I saw him once putting a large sack in the boot of his car, around midnight.

background: Retired civil servant; values routine and order.
Claims he was pruning hydrangeas from 8:30 to 9:30 as every Thursday.
Keeps timestamps on garden tasks in his notebook.
location_hints: I saw someone near the Study late that night. You should search there.
Tommy was fussing with the bathroom cabinet - claimed a leak, but I'm not so sure.
Check near the North Park gate. I've seen odd comings and goings there.

Ms. Banana: Observant neighbor who tends to gossip about minor details.
Runs her oven on high for pies; the kitchen window steams up.
Tommy the Janitor: Often around the building hallways; not very talkative.
Carries a ring of keys and a squeaky trolley.
Dr. Adrian Blackwood: Drives a dark saloon; parks facing east.

background: Was mopping ground floor hallway around 9:00.
Knows which flats have sticky locks and loose latches.
location_hints: I clean everywhere in this building. Check the bathroom cabinet - I found strange items there recently.
The Study had ash on the floor the other day. Something happened there.
I've got keys to everything. The North Park gate area sees late night visitors, if you catch my drift.

Ms. Banana: Always peeking through the curtains; knows what's going on.
Leaves flour on the landing when she bakes.
Mr. Holloway: Hydrangea clippings fill the green bin every Thursday.
Dr. Adrian Blackwood: Keeps his head down; few words outside the hospital.
Gets parcels marked 'fragile instruments' twice a month.

background: Respected surgeon; calm exterior; protective of reputation.
Keeps a tidy schedule; dislikes delays.
location_hints: I sometimes walk through North Park gate on my evening constitutional. Quiet area.
The Study is where the victim spent most of their time. You might find something there.
I prefer not to speculate on where evidence might be found. That's your job, Detective.

Ms. Banana: Long-time neighbor of the victim; tends to gossip.
Has a habit of 'tidying' others' rubbish bins.
Mr. Holloway: Dislikes disruptions; watches the street closely.
Wears gardening gloves even for light jobs.
Tommy the Janitor: Present in common areas; hears more than people assume.
Knows which residents skip paying maintenance on time.
